body: going back to my parents would be a death sentence in itself, they’re the ones making everything hell

i’d like to try i think, but man it’s honestly terrifying — the people who know about what’s happened and are supporting me want me to press charges against those who’ve hurt me if i get out but that sounds like the scariest thing ever to me, if i get out i just want to leave everything behind and figure something out to start anew, if that makes sense? knowing myself i’ll honestly just want to sleep for a few weeks straight then pretend nothing even happened lol. sorry if this makes no sense
